timeline.summary: Alldigi Tech received an income tax refund of ₹4.32 Cr for AY 2025-26.
Alldigi Tech reported Q4 FY26 revenue of ₹154.7 Cr (+5.9% YoY) and EBITDA of ₹43.7 Cr (+24.2% YoY).
Shivani Sharma (ACS-39590) uploaded the audio recording of the May 08, 2026 earnings conference call on the company’s website.
Alldigi Tech reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹154.7 Cr and announced a strategic shift towards international markets and AI-enabled payroll platforms.
Alldigi Tech appointed Manish Agarwal as CFO effective June 22, 2026, succeeding Avinash Jain.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹153.31 Cr (+4.0% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹26.58 Cr (+50.9% YoY).
Audio recording of the Earnings Conference call conducted on 30 October 2026 uploaded on the company website.

upcoming_events.description: Manish Agarwal assumes office as CFO
